findings_summary.description: Compact summary of ALL findings (BLOCKER, HIGH, MEDIUM) with specific fix instructions for each. This text is passed directly to the plan writer as revision instructions.

verdict_table.description: Markdown table with 13 axes: axis name, PASS/FAIL, issue count

new_issue_count.description: Number of issues in this review that are NEW (not present in any previous review context). On the first review, equals the total issue count.

rules_compliance.description: One entry per rule file in the AUTHORITATIVE PROJECT CONTEXT block (CLAUDE.md plus every file in .claude/rules/). For each rule file, decide whether the plan addresses it adequately for the task at hand. A rule that is NOT applicable to this task is still listed with addressed=true and note='not applicable: <reason>'. A rule the plan ignores while the task touches its scope is addressed=false and MUST be reflected in findings_summary. Do not skip files — incompleteness here means BLOCKER on the next review.

note.description: Short justification — which plan section satisfies this rule, or which invariant the plan violates / ignores.
